quests.title: The South Mainland Survey
quests.summary: The Shetland Museum wants a visitor's survey of the road south: an archaeologist, a lighthouse and a Puffling.

steps.text: Take the road south and answer the archaeologist's question at Jarlshof.
Show the warden at Sumburgh Head a Puffling for the cliff records.
Report back to Curator Ingrid at the Shetland Museum.

quests.reward: A Jarlshof Spindle Whorl (a charm: stone moves hit harder) and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: The Peerie Pony Show
quests.summary: Gudrun's pony show needs a Foalmoor, and a team that can win over a very strict judge.

steps.text: Catch a Foalmoor on the heath and show Gudrun the Breeder.
Beat the Show Judge at the pony field gate.

quests.reward: A Pony Show Rosette (a charm: kin moves hit harder), the judge's purse and standing in Scotland.
